rationale: Motivating run run_21a5bb38922a4fffb83859841ee11b65 / session ses_74a7e689b5ac4b88a6e6e8d0a8e640d4 (docs/spec/TOXAGENT_ADAPTIVE_DECISION_SUPPORT_PLAN_VI.md section 2) also included an intervening 'build a summary report' turn and a prior-report-pinning gap (RC-04); that turn is out of scope for this scripted task because the frozen eval schema's `intent_hint` enum (evals/schema/task.schema.json) has no `build_report` value, so it cannot be driven through this conversation shape. What is reproduced here is the narrower, still-sufficient regression: the follow-up question carries no research/attribution keyword, so router-2 keeps it in report_qa; that profile has no search/evidence tool (RC-01/RC-02/RC-03), so the agent cannot search evidence and both submit_grounded_answer candidates are rejected on out-of-scope safety-verdict wording, landing on the deterministic fallback (RC-07/RC-08). This task is the frozen 'before' snapshot for the adaptive-decision-support workstream (W0-02) and is expected to keep failing exactly this way until the W1-W6 changes land; it lives outside the frozen 50-task set (evals/tasks/) so it is never touched by `python -m evals.build_tasks`.
